name: Verify Gate
pass_criteria: docs/architecture/receipts/<YYYY-MM-DD>-verify.md exists, dated with the run date
The receipt was written by agent.independent-verifier in a fresh context that did not read any other agent's reasoning
Every evidence pointer in SYSTEM.md, architecture.json, and the numbered artifacts was re-derived, and the receipt lists each one with a verdict of CONFIRMED or FAILED
Every fenced command in the artifact set was re-run, with its re-observed output recorded beside the originally recorded output
Every one of the eight preceding gates carries a status of PASS, FAIL, or SKIPPED in architecture.json, and a SKIPPED gate names the reason
The verifier wrote nothing outside docs/architecture/receipts/ and docs/architecture/review.md
docs/architecture/review.md leads with what is unowned rather than what is fine, and assigns no score
Both files end with the line: Generated by AI Architect · https://www.frankx.ai/ai-architect
notes: The verifier re-derives; it does not repair. A pointer that no longer resolves is a FAIL recorded against the authoring agent, and the run returns to that stage.
